CustomField.description: Rich-text heading rendered at the top of the page body, above the page's sections, by the formTemplatePageSection LWC (lightning-formatted-rich-text bound to Page_Title__c). Use it for a formatted on-page headline or intro that is richer than the plain-text Page Label. Distinct from Page Label (the navigation/stage label) and Details (instructional body text). Also surfaced in FormTemplate_PDF_Controller output. HTML field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Add a formatted heading or intro shown at the top of the page body, above the sections — use it when you want styled text richer than the plain Page Label. This is on-page content, separate from the Page Label that drives the navigation indicator; leave it blank to show just the sections.
CustomField.label: Page Title
